gates.evidence: "Apply migrations to the CI database" succeeded against a fresh postgres:16 service container -- all 35 migrations, including 20260906000001_hierarchy_node_sow_index, apply cleanly from empty. Closes F6 from ART-20260906-063: this session's own checks ran against the already-migrated production database, not a bootstrap-from-empty; this run is that missing proof, run normally (via the master push trigger) rather than reproduced by hand. Full job: 23/23 steps succeeded (typecheck, tenancy, attribution, restore, estimation, contracts, migrations, persistence, scenario validation and its regression gate, build, package assembly).

security.reviewer: Independent general-purpose review agent, adversarial brief; verified the applied migration's row-count and lock-duration risk against real pg_class.reltuples figures rather than assuming, traced Postgres RESTRICT-constraint check semantics against the actual FK definition to determine when the check fires, and grepped every sowId reference across lib/, app/ and scripts/ to determine whether any SQL query pattern actually exists.

findings.summary: The original submission had no change-set or validation-result artifact.
The applied migration's comment claims a sequential-scan query pattern on sowId that does not exist in this codebase.
findings.disposition: accepted -- cannot be edited without breaking the applied migration's checksum; corrected record carried in ART-20260906-061

findings.summary: The applied migration's comment claims archiving a Sow triggers the Restrict constraint check; archiving is a soft-delete UPDATE that never fires it.
findings.disposition: accepted -- same checksum constraint as F2; corrected in ART-20260906-061

findings.summary: The plan overstated running the migration by hand as a deliberate exception to the CI/CD pipeline, when it is in fact how every release in this application's history has been made.
The plan's rollback note did not cover reconciling git history against the database's own _prisma_migrations record.
findings.disposition: fixed -- ART-20260906-062 adds the prisma migrate resolve step

findings.summary: This session's own checks did not reproduce a bootstrap-from-empty run of the full migration history.
findings.disposition: fixed -- CI run 34037931381 (see gates above) proves it, triggered normally by this batch's own merge to master
